prior_findings.evidence: main.ts:3338 converts optional reference-read rejection into a throwing commit closure. Primary result passes owner/generation/shape/month validation and paints before commit invocation. Catch retains GET-only retry and changed=true. new_findings.basis: source-confirmed control flow; no reviewer runtime reproduction
new_findings.problem: The deferred optional-error commit throws after primary paint but before the existing disconnected-parent-focus repair. If the primary board/modal repaint removed the focused parent control, this error path skips the repair and may leave focus on body.
new_findings.recommended_repair: Run the existing bounded parentOwnedFocus/disconnected/body focus repair before invoking the potentially throwing commit, or protect that repair in a narrowly scoped finally. Preserve the guards that prevent focus stealing when the user moved to a surviving control.
new_findings.required_runtime_case: Delay parent reads, move focus to a parent unit card/table/modal control that primary repaint replaces, then complete primary read successfully while rejecting fallback read. Confirm visible primary changes, retained fallback draft, recoverable error notice, and focus on an appropriate surviving status/control rather than body. Also test a newer surviving focus target remains focused.

effect_review.actual_delta: Exactly the five documented edits-from-v10r1: one optional-read catch, generated owner list label, retained list label, missing owner classification, and narrow empty-state removal. reference-workspace.ts bytes unchanged.
